1003a779eec0efe3fee2.text:
```sql
WITH store_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        s.region,
        SUM(f.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
    FROM analytics.dim_store AS s
    LEFT JOIN analytics.fct_sales AS f
        ON f.store_id = s.store_id
        AND f.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
        AND f.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    WHERE s.opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.region
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(net_revenue), 2) AS average_net_revenue_per_store
FROM store_revenue
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
```

```sql
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) AS snapshot_month
    FROM analytics.fct_inventory
)
SELECT
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_units * p.unit_cost), 2) AS inventory_value_at_cost
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN latest_snapshot AS ls
    ON i.snapshot_month = ls.snapshot_month
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region
```
